# Crew API: bots (Public endpoints)

Part of the [Crew API reference](README.md).

## GET /v1/crew/bots

List Bots and their status.

| About | This endpoint |
|---|---|
| Status | Planned |
| Tier | Public |
| Stability | preview |
| Callers the API defines | The owner, with the owner's own sign-in. An app, with a credential that holds the scope `bots:chat` or `bots:read`. |

A delegated credential lists only the grant's Bot range (bots.mode is selected, app_created or all); an empty range is an empty list. Only the roster and status: no private chat, briefing or rules.

Query parameters:

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `after` | string | no | Start after this id. |
| `limit` | integer (1 to 100, default `20`) | no |  |

Request headers:

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Crew-API-Version` | string | no | The minor version the client was written for. Without it, the server answers with 1.0 behaviour. The server never refuses a request because this version is old. |
| `X-Request-Id` | string | no | A caller may supply its own; an id assigned by an intermediary in front of the gateway wins. |

Response `200`: Success.

Response headers:

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `X-Request-Id` | string | One id per request, supplied by the caller or an intermediary, or generated by the gateway. Also written to the audit log and the error body. |

## POST /v1/crew/bots

Create a helper Bot.

| About | This endpoint |
|---|---|
| Status | Planned |
| Tier | Public |
| Stability | stable |
| Callers the API defines | The owner, with the owner's own sign-in. An app, with a credential that holds the scope `bots:create`. The app also needs the entitlement `bots.create`. |

For apps built around Bot collaboration: creates a Bot that does one small job, such as a secretary or a reviewer. Needs the restricted entitlement bots.create and the scope bots:create. The prompt and tools come only from a template in the manifest's bundle.bot_templates that the user consented to; a template name not in the manifest is 404. The request cannot carry prompt text or choose a model: the model is the helper-Bot tier the owner picked in the Kiro Crew settings. At most 16 per grant (a proposal); past that, 422 capability_unavailable. The created Bot has its own private memory, which the app cannot read.

Request headers:

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Crew-API-Version` | string | no | The minor version the client was written for. Without it, the server answers with 1.0 behaviour. The server never refuses a request because this version is old. |
| `X-Request-Id` | string | no | A caller may supply its own; an id assigned by an intermediary in front of the gateway wins. |
| `Idempotency-Key` | string | no | Accepted by every Public POST. Within one grant, a retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first result (the same object id) and is neither run again nor charged again; the same key with a different body is 422 idempotency_key_reused. |

Request body fields (`application/json`), [CreateBotRequest](schemas.md#createbotrequest):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `template` | string | yes | A template name in the manifest's bundle.bot_templates. |
| `name` | string | no | Display name; the template's name when omitted. |

Response `201`: The Bot that was created; it joins this grant's app_created range automatically.

Response headers:

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `X-Request-Id` | string | One id per request, supplied by the caller or an intermediary, or generated by the gateway. Also written to the audit log and the error body. |
| `Crew-API-Version` | string | The server's minor version, for example 1.3. |
| `X-Crew-Quota-Limit` | number | This grant's daily credit ceiling. Sent on every response to a delegated-credential request, success or failure; not sent for the embed credential. |
| `X-Crew-Quota-Remaining` | number | Credits left today (reservations already subtracted). |
| `X-Crew-Quota-Reset` | integer | When the quota resets, Unix seconds. |

Response body fields (`application/json`), [Bot](schemas.md#bot):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | Also the model value for /v1/responses. |
| `object` | `bot` | yes |  |
| `name` | string | yes |  |
| `description` | string | no |  |
| `avatar_url` | string or null | no |  |
| `status` | string: `idle`, `busy` | yes | busy means this Bot has a turn running right now (in whichever conversation). The values are the same as the App SDK's Bot. Open enum; a client treats an unknown value as idle. |
| `has_goal` | boolean | no | This Bot has a goal; when true, GET /v1/crew/bots/{bot_id}/goals has content to read. |
| `created_by_app` | boolean | no | true: this app created the Bot (bundle.kind bot or bots:create), so it is in the app_created range. |

## POST /v1/crew/bots/{bot_id}/wake

Wake a Bot.

| About | This endpoint |
|---|---|
| Status | Planned |
| Tier | Public |
| Stability | preview |
| Callers the API defines | The owner, with the owner's own sign-in. An app, with a credential that holds the scope `bots:wake`. |

The gateway sends the Bot only a fixed reminder it writes itself ("You have a new message from \<app name>, number \<ref>"), with the app name taken from the app's registration record. The request body has nothing but ref, so no text can ride along. The turn runs in an app-room conversation dedicated to this (Bot x grant) pair, with only the tools listed in the manifest's bundle.wake_tools; it reads the Bot's own memory and writes none. One (Bot x grant) pair has at most one queued wake; later ones are merged (coalesced). When the Bot is not online the wake is deferred and runs when it is back. Limits: 20 per hour for each (grant x Bot) pair and 120 per hour for each grant, both proposals. Past them, 429 rate_limited with limit bot_wakes or grant_wakes in the error body. A Bot outside the grant's Bot range is 404. The turn's usage is in the bot.turn.completed event.

Path parameters:

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bot_id` | string | yes | Bot id; must be in the grant's Bot range. |

Request headers:

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Crew-API-Version` | string | no | The minor version the client was written for. Without it, the server answers with 1.0 behaviour. The server never refuses a request because this version is old. |
| `X-Request-Id` | string | no | A caller may supply its own; an id assigned by an intermediary in front of the gateway wins. |
| `Idempotency-Key` | string | no | Accepted by every Public POST. Within one grant, a retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first result (the same object id) and is neither run again nor charged again; the same key with a different body is 422 idempotency_key_reused. |

Request body fields (`application/json`), [BotWakeRequest](schemas.md#botwakerequest):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ref` | string | yes | The number of that message in the app's own ledger: 1 to 64 letters, digits, _, ., : or -, the same as the App SDK's wake. This character set cannot hold a sentence. |

Response `202`: Accepted. status says whether the turn already started, a new turn was queued, the wake was merged into a turn already queued, or it waits until the Bot is back.

Response headers:

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `X-Request-Id` | string | One id per request, supplied by the caller or an intermediary, or generated by the gateway. Also written to the audit log and the error body. |
| `Crew-API-Version` | string | The server's minor version, for example 1.3. |
| `X-Crew-Quota-Limit` | number | This grant's daily credit ceiling. Sent on every response to a delegated-credential request, success or failure; not sent for the embed credential. |
| `X-Crew-Quota-Remaining` | number | Credits left today (reservations already subtracted). |
| `X-Crew-Quota-Reset` | integer | When the quota resets, Unix seconds. |

Response body fields (`application/json`), [BotWake](schemas.md#botwake):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `object` | `bot.wake` | yes |  |
| `id` | string | yes |  |
| `bot` | string | yes |  |
| `ref` | string | yes | This wake's ref. After a merge, the Bot sees the latest ref when it wakes. |
| `status` | string: `started`, `queued`, `coalesced`, `deferred` | yes | started: the Bot was idle and the turn is already running; queued: a new turn was queued and waits for the Bot's current turn to end; coalesced: merged into a turn already queued; deferred: the Bot is not online and runs it when it is back. started and queued mean the same as in the App SDK's wake. |
| `usage` | [BotWakeUsage](schemas.md#botwakeusage) | yes |  |

Errors. The response body is [Error](schemas.md#error); its `error.code` field holds the code.

Carries X-Crew-Quota-* on delegated-credential requests. |
| 404 | `not_found`, `model_not_found` | 404: not_found, model_not_found. Carries X-Crew-Quota-* on delegated-credential requests. |
| 429 | `rate_limited`, `concurrency_limit`, `quota_exhausted`, `notification_limited` | 429: rate_limited, concurrency_limit, quota_exhausted, notification_limited. Carries X-Crew-Quota-* on delegated-credential requests. |
| 500 | `internal_error` | 500: internal_error. Carries X-Crew-Quota-* on delegated-credential requests. |
